subject: AitW status: per-subset baselines, instruction-source skew
body:
Hi Priya, Santiago,

Baselines are in. Step accuracy by subset: Install 68%, first-party apps 59%, WebShopping 47%, General 41%. Single-step is 74%, which we expected. WebShopping is hardest — tasks like looking up a best-rated item on a retailer site involve search, scroll, and cart state that our action head handles badly.

Risk: the natural language instructions come from mixed sources — humans, language models, and technical documentation — and the phrasing distributions differ noticeably per source. Our model does 9 points better on model-written instructions than on human-written ones, which is exactly backwards from what production needs. We're stratifying eval by instruction source so this stops hiding in the aggregate.

Fumiko
